what: piece of cha chaan teng kitchen equipment
scale: One scale for all, the same as the board's counters (the long cashier counter there is about 2.2 m long and waist-high).

items.name: wok_range
items.look: a Cantonese wok range about 2.2 m long and waist-high: a stainless steel body with three round burner wells in a row, a black carbon-steel wok sitting in each, a little stir-fry in the middle wok, a water tap arm over the back edge; its long front faces down-left

items.name: hood
items.look: a stainless steel kitchen extractor hood, a long sloping canopy with a square duct going straight up from its top, mounted on the back wall; its long front faces down-left; nothing under it

items.name: prep_counter
items.look: a stainless steel prep counter about 1.5 m long and waist-high, an undershelf below, a wooden chopping board with a cleaver and a small pile of chopped spring onion on top, a steel stock pot at one end; its long front faces down-left

items.name: pass
items.look: a kitchen pass: a waist-high plastered wall section about 1.1 m long topped by a wide stainless steel shelf, a small brass service bell on the shelf, otherwise empty; its long front faces down-left

items.name: stock_pot
items.look: a huge aluminium stock pot with a lid on a low single-ring gas stove standing on the floor, a ladle resting against it
